title: Understanding Residuals
text: Residuals are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values. If all residuals are negative, it means that the predicted values are consistently higher than the observed values.

title: Intercept Term in OLS
text: The intercept term in a regression model accounts for the baseline level of the dependent variable when all predictors are zero. Without it, the model may not accurately capture the relationship between the predictors and the target variable.
